<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/builds/totals"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Build count, failure rate, p50/p90 duration and total duration over the requested
time window, without any grouping. Durations are in seconds, failure rate is a
percentage in 0-100. The window may span at most 2 years.
